program.section_heading: Advanced English Fluency Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Compose narrative, descriptive and opinion paragraphs that demonstrate clarity of expression, correct paragraph form, and command of basic grammatical structures.
Demonstrate comprehension of main ideas found in authentic reading passages, both expository and fiction, using complete sentences that show command of basic grammatical structures.
Demonstrate comprehension of main ideas found in listening passages using complete sentences that show command of basic grammatical structures.

notes: The catalog prints the codes without a space (ESL343, ESL344). They match the closed-list entries ESL 343 and ESL 344, so they are not marked as catalog additions.
This is a noncredit award counted in hours. The 216 total and the 108 hours per course are taken from the catalog, not from the closed list's 0 units.
The program map (Fall: ESL343; Spring: ESL344) repeats the same requirements and was not recorded as separate blocks.
The description says the certificate shows mastery in 'beginning English', which seems inconsistent with the Advanced title; it is recorded as printed and should be checked.
